# Switch

[← Slider](slider.md) · [All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [Airplane →](airplane.md)

<img src="../gifs/switch.gif" width="300" alt="Switch">

A switch whose track color and thumb animate together, at any size and in any colors.

Reanimated docs: [examples/switch](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/examples/switch)

## What to look at

- The track color is `withTiming(interpolateColor(...))` and the thumb is `withTiming(interpolate(...))`, both as `useDerivedAnimation`.
- Several switches share one shared value, so they all move together.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

### `lib/src/screens/switch_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import '../components/animated_switch.dart';

/// examples/switch: a switch whose track color and thumb animate together,
/// at any size and in any colors.
class SwitchScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SwitchScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SwitchScreen> createState() => _SwitchScreenState();
}

class _SwitchScreenState extends State<SwitchScreen> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final isOn = useSharedValue(false);
  late final label = useDerivedValue(() => 'Switch value: ${isOn.value}');

  void handlePress() => isOn.value = !isOn.value;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DemoPage(
        title: 'Switch',
        docs: 'examples/switch',
        child: Column(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(height: 32),
            AnimatedSwitch(value: isOn, onPress: handlePress, width: 200, height: 80),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            AnimatedPropsBuilder(
              props: label,
              builder: (context, text) => Text(text, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 40),
            const Text('Shared value, several switches'),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceEvenly,
              children: [
                AnimatedSwitch(value: isOn, onPress: handlePress),
                AnimatedSwitch(
                  value: isOn,
                  onPress: handlePress,
                  width: 90,
                  height: 44,
                  trackColors: (on: Palette.purple, off: const Color(0xFFC9CCD8)),
                ),
                AnimatedSwitch(
                  value: isOn,
                  onPress: handlePress,
                  width: 50,
                  height: 28,
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 900),
                  trackColors: (on: Palette.navy, off: Palette.yellow),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/animated_switch.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// The Reanimated site's `Switch`: the track's color is interpolateColor'd
/// between the off and on colors and the thumb slides across, both with
/// withTiming (400 ms). Track size is measured, so any width and height work.
class AnimatedSwitch extends StatefulWidget {
  const AnimatedSwitch({
    super.key,
    required this.value,
    required this.onPress,
    this.width = 64,
    this.height = 36,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
    this.trackColors = (on: const Color(0xFF82CAB2), off: const Color(0xFFFA7F7C)),
  });

  final SharedValue<bool> value;
  final VoidCallback onPress;
  final double width;
  final double height;
  final Duration duration;
  final ({Color on, Color off}) trackColors;

  @override
  State<AnimatedSwitch> createState() => _AnimatedSwitchState();
}

class _AnimatedSwitchState extends State<AnimatedSwitch> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final height = useSharedValue(widget.height);
  late final width = useSharedValue(widget.width);

  late final trackColor = useDerivedAnimation(
    widget.value.value ? widget.trackColors.on : widget.trackColors.off,
    () => withTiming(
      interpolateColor(widget.value.value ? 1 : 0, [0, 1], [widget.trackColors.off, widget.trackColors.on]),
      duration: widget.duration,
    ),
  );
  late final thumbX = useDerivedAnimation(
    0.0,
    () => withTiming(
      interpolate(widget.value.value ? 1 : 0, [0, 1], [0, width.value - height.value]),
      duration: widget.duration,
    ),
  );

  late final trackAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        backgroundColor: trackColor.value,
        borderRadius: height.value / 2,
      ));
  late final thumbAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        translateX: thumbX.value,
        borderRadius: height.value / 2,
      ));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => GestureDetector(
        onTap: widget.onPress,
        child: AnimatedView(
          onLayout: (size) {
            height.value = size.height;
            width.value = size.width;
          },
          style: Styles([
            AnimatedStyle(width: widget.width, height: widget.height),
            trackAnimatedStyle,
          ]),
          child: Align(
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(widget.height * 0.08),
              child: AnimatedView(
                style: Styles([
                  AnimatedStyle(
                    width: widget.height * 0.84,
                    height: widget.height * 0.84,
                    backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
                  ),
                  thumbAnimatedStyle,
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
}
```
